html:
G'oya

Ikki jadvaldagi bir xil qatorlar, ya'ni ikki to'plamning kesishmasi. INTERSECT qatorlarni barcha ustunlari bo'yicha solishtiradi, takrorlarni olib tashlaydi va NULLni NULLga teng deb hisoblaydi. Bu masalada uchala xususiyat ham kerak.

Yechim

SELECT name, email, phone FROM import_a
INTERSECT
SELECT name, email, phone FROM import_b

Tuzoqlar

JOIN bilan yozilganda a.phone = b.phone sharti NULLlar uchun bajarilmaydi: NULL = NULL rost emas, noma'lum. Namunada Malika Tosheva ikkala importda telefonsiz turibdi, lekin bu so'rov uni topmaydi:

Noto'g'riSELECT DISTINCT a.name, a.email, a.phone
FROM import_a a
JOIN import_b b ON b.name = a.name AND b.email = a.email AND b.phone = a.phone

NULLni alohida tekshirib tuzatsangiz ham, DISTINCTni unutmang. Aziz Karimov import_ada ikki marta yozilgan, JOIN uni ikki marta chiqaradi.

Faqat email bo'yicha solishtirish ham yetmaydi. Bekzod Aliyevning emaili ikkala importda bir xil, telefoni esa har xil, demak bu bir xil yozuv emas.

Boshqa yo'l

JOIN bilan NULLni hisobga oladigan shart:

SELECT DISTINCT a.name, a.email, a.phone
FROM import_a a
JOIN import_b b
  ON b.name = a.name AND b.email = a.email
 AND (b.phone = a.phone OR (b.phone IS NULL AND a.phone IS NULL))

Dialektlar farqi

Ikkala bazada NULLni hisobga oladigan taqqoslash bor, lekin nomi har xil. PostgreSQL'da a.phone IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.phone, SQLite'da a.phone IS b.phone.

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT DISTINCT a.name, a.email, a.phone
FROM import_a a
JOIN import_b b ON b.name = a.name AND b.email = a.email AND b.phone IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.phone
Faqat SQLiteSELECT DISTINCT a.name, a.email, a.phone
FROM import_a a
JOIN import_b b ON b.name = a.name AND b.email = a.email AND b.phone IS a.phone
